summary: Tested i18n translation coverage after major refactoring. Fixed 2 critical bugs where `t()` function was used without proper imports. All tested pages show translated placeholders correctly - no raw translation keys visible.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: KarauMeetLogin.jsx - Added missing `import { useTranslation } from '@/utils/i18n'` and `const { t } = useTranslation()` - was causing runtime error
FIXED: CompanyProfilePage.jsx - Added missing `const { t } = useTranslation()` destructuring - t() was undefined
context_for_next_testing_agent: i18n refactoring complete. All form placeholders use t() function for translations. Language selector with 33+ languages works. Two critical bugs were fixed: KarauMeetLogin.jsx and CompanyProfilePage.jsx both had missing useTranslation imports/destructuring.

bug_1.issue: Using t() function without importing useTranslation hook

bug_2.fix: Added: const { t } = useTranslation() in component
